name: bydper-loop-archive
goal: Record genuine red and green checkpoints when the committed snapshot exceeds 8 MiB

evidence: Checkpoint startup captures git archive stdout through GitAdapter. GitAdapter raises the generic 8 MiB cap to 128 MiB in this revision, but the reported repository archive is roughly 170 MB. The checkpoint command must run on that exact commit.

The registered SnapshotAdapter export example and loop CLI bug-fix matrix only commit small source files. Add a large committed asset to the existing fixtures, verify its export, and require the normal CLI matrix to retain red and green evidence.

The committed loop CLI test fixture contains a 129 MiB tracked file. The unchanged Vitest command fails because the nested loop record red command aborts with BoundedCommandFailure: Command output limit exceeded.
Git writes the archive to a private temporary file. Bounded tar extracts into a sibling source directory, then the archive is removed. Setup errors remove the temporary workspace.
Matched checkpoints replay the committed loop CLI test unchanged. 163e0c174d fails with the 129 MiB archive output limit; 6127781a76 records both phases and passes.

Scoped proof passed: matched CLI regression, standalone 129 MiB replay, 11 snapshot unit tests, root audit, targeted lint and CLI build. Root aggregate reported existing registry failures verified on clean main and host timeouts.
